gaps.title: Billing parity
acceptance: Pulse billing surface is functionally equivalent to web billing behavior
Redirect shims are replaced with explicit ownership decision and tested behavior parity

gaps.title: SDK/ingest onboarding parity
acceptance: Pulse onboarding includes explicit ingest verification path equivalent to web onboarding SDK flow
SDK key env naming is canonicalized (RELIAI_API_KEY) with no conflicting key names

gaps.title: API route ownership parity
acceptance: Billing checkout ownership is explicitly implemented in Pulse or explicitly externalized
Config apply/undo ownership is explicitly implemented in Pulse or explicitly externalized
Prompts diff ownership is explicitly implemented in Pulse or explicitly externalized
System limits ownership is explicitly implemented in Pulse or explicitly externalized

gaps.title: Auth callback / SSO parity
acceptance: Pulse has auth callback parity for SSO flows or explicit externalized ownership with test gate
Auth callback ownership and failure behavior are documented and contract-tested

gaps.title: Docs parity
acceptance: Pulse docs ownership decision is explicit (full migrate or externalized)
Simplified wrapper is not treated as equivalent to web docs tree without explicit exception

gaps.title: Route inventory completeness
acceptance: Unmatched web route files are classified as migrate / intentionally externalized / obsolete / deferred blocker
No unmatched high-impact route remains unowned
